questions.prompt: The town considers good intentions a positive point, but says they did not solve the timing problem. Choose the concessive linker: ___ the intentions were good, the timetable remained impractical.
questions.explanation: 题干明确要求让步：承认出发点好，仍指出期限不现实。Because改成原因，Unless改成条件；So不能在此引导前置从句。
questions.evidence: The town considers good intentions a positive point, but says they did not solve the timing problem. Choose the concessive linker: Although the intentions were good, the timetable remained impractical.

questions.prompt: Preserve the stated condition: If you do not study harder, you will fail the exam. You will fail the exam ___ you study harder.
questions.explanation: unless等于if not，保留“不更努力就不及格”的条件。if不含否定，because改成努力造成失败，so改成结果关系，均不保持原意。
questions.evidence: Preserve the stated condition: If you do not study harder, you will fail the exam. You will fail the exam unless you study harder.

questions.prompt: Express the stated result, not a reason for being tired: She was tired, ___ she went to bed early.
questions.explanation: 要求由疲倦推出早睡，so引结果；because会把早睡变成疲倦的原因，although表示反预期，unless表示条件，均改变所要求的关系。
questions.evidence: Express the stated result, not a reason for being tired: She was tired, so she went to bed early.

questions.prompt: His lateness caused him to miss the opening. Choose the causal linker: ___ he was late, he missed the beginning.
questions.explanation: 题干已明确迟到是原因，Because后接完整从句；Although改成让步，Unless改成条件，So不能按此结构引前置原因。
questions.evidence: His lateness caused him to miss the opening. Choose the causal linker: Because he was late, he missed the beginning.

options: Although it was raining, but we went out.
Although it was raining, we went out.
Although it was raining, so we went out.
Although it was raining, because we went out.
answers: Although it was raining, we went out.
questions.explanation: 在这里，although 已引导让步从句，主句前不再加 but 或 so；because 会使后半句也成为从句，缺少主句。正确句为 Although it was raining, we went out。
questions.evidence: Although it was raining, we went out.

questions.prompt: Preserve the meaning: Publication of the methods is necessary for approval, but does not by itself guarantee approval. The council will approve the study ___ the methods are published.
questions.explanation: only if引必要条件：获得批准必须先公开方法。even if表示即使、whether or not表示无论是否，均取消必要性；as if表达仿佛而非条件。
questions.evidence: Preserve the meaning: Publication of the methods is necessary for approval, but does not by itself guarantee approval. The council will approve the study only if the methods are published.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the high cost, the project was completed.
questions.explanation: Despite 是介词，后接名词短语；Although 后接从句。这里 the high cost 是名词短语，所以用 Despite。
questions.evidence: Despite the high cost, the project was completed.

questions.prompt: Preserve uncertainty about a past cause: The fall in pollution ___ from heavier rainfall, but the team has not established the cause.
questions.explanation: may have +过去分词表示对过去原因的可能推断；must have过强，cannot have排除可能，will result改成将来，均不符合尚未确定的过去原因。
questions.evidence: Preserve uncertainty about a past cause: The fall in pollution may have resulted from heavier rainfall, but the team has not established the cause.

title: The River Cleanup Debate: Policy at Three Scales · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
让步承认一个事实但指出预期结果未发生，例如原句though well-intentioned承认政策出发点好，却不能解决地方期限问题。完整让步从句用although/though + 主语 + 谓语；同一主语的be有时可省略。despite是介词，接名词或-ing，不能直接接完整从句。because引原因、so/therefore引结果，不能不顾实际逻辑互换。unless表示if not；only if表示必要条件而不是保证结果。正式论证还要区分may（可能）与must（必要/强推断），避免把证据写得过强。

The national policy, though well-intentioned, did not fit the local timeline.
